name: Path Analysis
description: The most common event sequences per user or session, step-numbered transitions for Sankey charts, and next-step probabilities.
introductoryText:
Finds the **most common sequences of events** per user or session (web pages, app screens, case or claim stages, patient pathways, machine states) and the **transitions** between steps.

- Events are ordered by time within each path; **repeated consecutive events** can be collapsed (*home > home > product* becomes *home > product*)
- Paths can **start** at the first occurrence of an event (for example *product*) and **stop** at the first of your **end events** (for example *purchase*)
- Paths are cut to a **maximum number of steps**, with *...* marking longer ones

Outputs:
- **Paths**: the top paths with counts, share, cumulative share, how many reach an end event and the median duration
- **Transitions**: step-numbered links (*1. home* to *2. product*), with *(exit)* where paths stop: ready for a Sankey chart
- **Next step**: the probability of each next event after each event (a Markov transition table), including leaving

options.name: path_field
options.title: User or session field
options.description: Identifies one path: all events with the same value form a sequence.

options.name: event_field
options.title: Event field
options.description: The page, screen or step recorded in each event.

options.name: time_field
options.title: Time field (optional)
options.description: Orders the events; without it, input order is used.

options.name: max_steps
options.title: Maximum steps
options.description: Paths are cut after this many steps, so long journeys group together.

options.name: collapse_repeats
options.title: Collapse repeated consecutive events
options.description: Treats the same event several times in a row (such as page reloads) as one step.

options.name: start_event
options.title: Start at event (optional)
options.description: Paths start at its first occurrence; paths without it are left out.

options.name: end_events
options.title: End events (optional)
options.description: Comma-separated; a path stops at the first one, for example: purchase

blockOutputs.label: Paths
blockOutputs.tooltip: Top paths: rank, path, steps, count, share, cumulative share, first / last event, reached end event, median minutes.

blockOutputs.label: Transitions
blockOutputs.tooltip: Step-numbered From / To links with counts, for Sankey charts.

blockOutputs.label: Next step
blockOutputs.tooltip: From event, to event (or exit), transitions and probability.
